propositions: Git >=2.47 runs git maintenance run --auto foreground inside git commit, charging O(store) repack cost to the lock-held commit subprocess bounded by _GIT_TIMEOUT=30s, which SIGKILLs mid-repack when repack exceeds 30s on a mature store with >~6700 loose objects.

Every lock-held store-commit surface that constructs its own git argv (event_append, txn, delete, compact_plan, compact, fsck_repair) must suppress auto-maintenance on the commit itself (-c gc.auto=0 -c maintenance.auto=false) and run deferred maintenance as an explicit budgeted step under the 120s _LOCAL_GIT_TIMEOUT watchdog, preserving ADR 0051 serialization.

The 30s per-commit latency bound on lock-held git children is a network-grade value copied from push.py; foreground O(store) maintenance must not be charged to a per-operation latency watchdog, only to a watchdog-grade timeout after acquisition.
Regression test with store past loose threshold and _GIT_TIMEOUT monkeypatched small must fail before the fix (git timed out) and pass after (write succeeds with deferred maintenance).

The defect is regression from c2ba (commit 3aec0ae90ab) which added _GIT_TIMEOUT=30 to lock-held commits 13 days after ADR 0051 (2026-07-18) introduced foreground maintenance, violating ADR 0051's own serialization invariant when SIGKILL lands mid-repack.

Relationship to prior tickets: moldavite-evasive-elephant (9590-34f5) first recorded occurrence (misclassified as runner I/O); royal-weariless-zebrafish (10c3-5a33) is distinct pre-lock acquire timeout mechanism, not addressed by this fix.
